authored.context: Retail func_0023A5EC computes each newly allocated resource-row index from the row address and D_80195560 using 0xC4EC4EC5, mult, mflo and arithmetic shift by two. The previous C draft divided a byte-address difference by 0x34 and the pinned compiler emitted a full unsigned reciprocal division sequence instead. Static row stepping and the adjacent builder identify a 0x34-byte row stride.
authored.label: scenario-typed-52-byte-row-difference
authored.observedEffect: Authenticated pinned-compiler watch emitted the retail 0xC4EC4EC5 low-word multiply, mflo and sra row-index sequence in the initial and optional paths. The partial-output source remained 2640 bytes/660 instructions, frame 128, zero actual-only and three expected-only instructions against retail 2652/663; differing bytes fell only from 2233 to 2231 amid broad alignment differences. The all-output-pointer spelling with the same typed row index was 2568/642 at frame 128, so the type alone does not restore repeated-case extent.
authored.remainingFailure: The candidate is still 12 bytes short with broad register, opcode and control-address differences, and has no accepted linked relocation contract. The casted subtraction assumes both mapped addresses refer to one row table; formal source provenance and fields require reconciliation before production. Original ASM remains active, and no final scenario wave verifier ran.
authored.sourceChange: Introduce an opaque 0x34-byte ResourceRow type and compute the row index by subtracting ResourceRow pointers. Retain the first-row marker, partial output-base alias and indexed initial output counter.
